newsitem.title: BOTSWANA: BOTSWANAN STOCKS WEEK - INDEX MAKES SMALL GAINS.
newsitem.headline: BOTSWANAN STOCKS WEEK - INDEX MAKES SMALL GAINS.

text.p: small volumes on the Botswana Stock Exchange last week but the
overall value of the trade was down from the week before.
The index gained 0.45 points to close at 352.64 points.
Of the 12 counters, all but five traded. Kgolo ya Sechaba,
which traded up five thebe to 135 thebe, was the only gain. No
Untraded were Barclays, Metsef, Pep, Sefalana, and Standard
